about: DEVBOARD-3 · How a gift flows through Steward, drawn on /ops?tab=flow. Each box names the modules it lives in (tests/devboard3-journey.test.js fails if one stops existing), the queue jobs it runs on, and its area on the Map (ops/map.json).

boxes.title: Import
boxes.says: A file of people and gifts: the one reader, a preview, then Done, with Undo.

boxes.title: Add gift
boxes.says: A person records a gift by hand on a profile or a deposit.

boxes.title: Giving page
boxes.says: A donor gives on the public page; Stripe Connect confirms it and the webhook records it.

boxes.title: People and gifts
boxes.says: recordGift writes the gift (the one gift path); the after-change step updates the person and writes the event to the outbox.

boxes.title: shared/numbers
boxes.says: One home per number: money, lifetime, last gift, lapse, the fiscal year. Every screen reads these.

boxes.title: Scores and rhythm
boxes.says: The worker rescores the people a change touched, and reads each giver's rhythm.

boxes.title: Home moves
boxes.says: Home opens on one decision: a name, a reason and a step.

boxes.title: Insights
boxes.says: Patterns ranked by dollars, each reason a computed fact that opens its rows.

boxes.title: Re-engage
boxes.says: Who is drifting or lapsed, and the step that would bring them back.

boxes.title: Journeys and emails
boxes.says: Drafts and journeys. A person wrote every word and turned it on; each send is theirs.

boxes.title: Receipts
boxes.says: A receipt per gift and the year-end statement, from the org's legal entity.

boxes.title: Reports and Finance
boxes.says: Every figure opens its rows, footing to the cent; deposits and month close.
